title: Base Read Holding Registers request and response
purpose: Cover sequential parsing of a complete request and its matching multi-register response without adding an unrelated setup request.

messages.label: Read Holding Registers request, unit 17, start 32, quantity 4
Read Holding Registers response, unit 17, four register values

expected_behavior: The server should parse the request as Read Holding Registers for unit 17 and return eight data bytes representing four registers, or return a protocol-level exception if the range is unavailable. The response matches the request transaction and unit identifiers.
constraints_preserved: Both frames contain 7-byte MBAP headers with protocol identifier 0000.
The request MBAP length is 0006 and matches the unit identifier plus the 5-byte request PDU.
The response MBAP length is 000b and matches the unit identifier plus a function byte, byte-count byte, and eight data bytes.
Function code 03, starting address 0020, and quantity 0004 are ordered and complete.
The response byte count is 08, matching four two-byte registers.
The response transaction identifier 0100 and unit identifier 11 match the request.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. This sequence is intended to exercise complete request and response parsing and does not encode a known issue or vulnerability claim.
